answer: Here is one mechanism that works: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because zephyr only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, tide is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any delta approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
